errorStackExactOptionalPropertyTypes.ts(27,16): error TS2379: Argument of type 'Error' is not assignable to parameter of type '{ message: string; stack?: string; }' with 'exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true'. Consider adding 'undefined' to the types of the target's properties.
  Types of property 'stack' are incompatible.
    Type 'string | undefined' is not assignable to type 'string'.
      Type 'undefined' is not assignable to type 'string'.


==== errorStackExactOptionalPropertyTypes.ts (1 errors) ====
    // https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/issues/45748
    
    // An Error subtype may declare `stack` as possibly undefined.
    interface MyError extends Error {
        stack: string | undefined;
    }
    
    declare const myError: MyError;
    const asError: Error = myError;
    
    // `stack` may be explicitly set to undefined.
    declare const err: Error;
    err.stack = undefined;
    
    // Narrowing `stack` back to `string` in a subtype is still allowed.
    interface StrictStackError extends Error {
        stack?: string;
    }
    
    class StrictStackErrorClass extends Error {
        declare stack?: string;
    }
    
    // Trade-off: an Error is no longer assignable to a type whose optional `stack`
    // excludes undefined.
    declare function takesErrorLike(e: { message: string; stack?: string }): void;
    takesErrorLike(err);
                   ~~~
!!! error TS2379: Argument of type 'Error' is not assignable to parameter of type '{ message: string; stack?: string; }' with 'exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true'. Consider adding 'undefined' to the types of the target's properties.
!!! error TS2379:   Types of property 'stack' are incompatible.
!!! error TS2379:     Type 'string | undefined' is not assignable to type 'string'.
!!! error TS2379:       Type 'undefined' is not assignable to type 'string'.
